Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You spread your tools on a cloth and turn a stopping place into a workshop.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
The recipe’s stated interval per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One known compatible ordinary recipe; recipe interval
Duration
Crafted items and supplies persist until used or destroyed.
Equipment / acquisition
Craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent; choose two compatible ordinary recipes. No materials granted.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Utility

Requires a known ordinary recipe. Grants craft tools if absent and two compatible ordinary recipe choices. Recipe defines materials, time and completion; no free materials.

Weak
1 progress or inventory step.
Standard
2 progress or inventory steps.
Strong
3 progress or inventory steps.

Compatible ordinary choices are Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. Other recipe types require their named crafting permission.
